title: Portable pinned-corpus roots for two cumulative unit checks
api_or_output: Two original-byte checks honor the existing XEMELE_CORPUS_RESOURCES setting without changing source bytes, hashes or assertions.

acceptance.description: Both formerly fixed local corpus paths honor the existing corpus-root environment setting; original byte/hash/model assertions pass from an isolated root.

handoff.summary: Demonstrated hosted missing-file failures expose two remaining fixed local paths; repair is limited to selecting the existing corpus-root environment setting.
